Convenience store employee Matsuhiro Sakurai is always getting called out by his best friend, Officer Kazuma Shinozaki, and he’s got a problem.

He’s got absolutely no experience in the bedroom!

Even though he sees hot women all over the place, he just can’t make it work. Why?

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Jiyuu Inpon Tou
  • 発売日: 2019-10-06
  • スコア: 6.69/10 (44 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 母さん愛してる～人生をかけた母親陥落大作戦～
  • 英語名: Kaa-san Aishiteru Jinsei o Kaketa Hahaoya Kanraku Daisakusen

别名

  • I Love You

あらすじ

Haruki loves his mother Yuuko so much that he wants to marry her.

“You need to courage to be strong enough to come take me from your dad. Women like that kind of stuff, you know.”

Just a friendly everyday conversation, or so she thought. But Haruki treated it like a promise, and as he grew, he waited for his chance.
